title: SURFRAD radiation and weather across two sites and seasons
release_or_version: January and July 2026; Desert Rock NV and Penn State PA
license_or_access_terms: U.S. government public-domain observations; NOAA acknowledgment
deterministic_selection_rule: All daily DAT files for January and July 2026, both fixed sites (124 complete days), plus original format documentation. No weather-based selection.

measurement_dates.description: All January and July 2026 days at Desert Rock NV and Penn State PA; daily files carry source year/day/time fields.
measurement_dates.status: documented where explicit; otherwise unknown, never inferred from release

author_preprocessing: NOAA calibrated station observations, commonly one-minute records, with source flags. The selection uses whole calendar months at two fixed sites and does not filter weather or quality.
known_analyses_and_limitations: Radiation partitioning has extensive established theory. Geometric radiation identities are not new findings. Two sites and two months leave seasonal/regional confounding and cannot establish climate trends.
